summary: IconSwap's swap now reads as one glyph re-forming instead of a pop, decided in review: the hidden state dips to scale 0.8 (was 0.5) and blurs to 2px, so the old glyph shrinks and softens away on --ui-duration-fast while the new one grows back and sharpens on --ui-duration-base. Scale is 1 − 0.2 × --ui-motion-travel and blur 2px × travel, so Reduced and Off stay a plain cross-fade with no code. The shown glyph has no filter at all — not blur(0) — so it is never left on its own compositing layer at rest (craft rule 23); a test asserts filter: none, probed by leaving blur(0) in place. The sheet's 0.5 reading is replaced and badged Decided; the catalogue motif follows.
